name: The Herders' Terraces
description: Stone steps up a hillside, grazed by goats, described in the archive as ornamental.
arrival: Two hundred steps of dry-laid stone, each one a little lower at the outer edge than the inner. Marn's goats are on them. The University's survey calls them a devotional feature and gives them a paragraph.
notes: The archaeology discovery and the restore target. A paragraph in the survey against two hundred courses of deliberate engineering is the whole argument of this map in one image.
